correctness.rationale: The stage-success rate is (r-1)(n+1)/(nr), and failures consist of two independent Exp(r) holding periods; independent post-merger hub vacancies introduce Bernoulli(1/(n+1)) Exp(r) delays. Their product gives the finite transform and mean exactly. The monotone geometric coupling bounds mean distance by (3H_n-1)/(n+1), and summable independent-stage variances yield the centered law and explicit cumulants. Full-subset rational generator solutions for n<=6 reproduce transforms and means and for n<=5 reproduce variances: 467 assertions passed. Remaining risk is mathematical review of the analytic coupling and asymptotic uniform integrability; finite tests alone are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivating same mathematical model star literature gives a logarithmic lower bound. An exact finite Laplace transform, additive mean correction, explicit non-Gumbel fluctuation law, and calculable cumulants resolve a natural distributional question about hub-excursion coalescence that is not determined by the bound. Such results can be benchmarks for voter-model duality and nonhomogeneous coalescing graph families; no conjectural downstream general theorem is claimed.
